name: Nakagawa (Tokushima, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nakagawa town emblem in white: a ring with two pointed ears enclosing three vertical bars.
history: Flag of the former town of Nakagawa in Tokushima Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-03-20. The municipal emblem was adopted in 1968.

features.role: Nakagawa town emblem — a ring with two pointed ears enclosing three vertical bars
